title: 真实HTTP权限与CORS分离：允许来源仍需认证授权，无Origin也不能绕过
source: OpsForge 身份与安全补充编审
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现protect(app,authenticate,authorize,allowed_origin)，返回WSGI middleware。只有GET受保护业务请求：解析Bearer token，authenticate(token)返回身份或None；无身份401且WWW-Authenticate: Bearer，无读取授权403，成功将身份放入environ副本的opsforge.identity后调用app。Origin只影响浏览器可读响应头，不能代替上述两步；来自非批准Origin但身份/对象权限有效的非浏览器请求仍可200，但不加CORS许可头。仅与allowed_origin精确相等时添加ACAO=该来源和ACAC=true；移除下游旧CORS许可头，合并Vary并保留下游Accept-Encoding等已有项，大小写不敏感去重后补Origin，已有Vary:*则保持*。OPTIONS返回204空体，不认证、不调用业务，仅批准来源附GET/Authorization预检许可；其他方法405。任何来源未认证/无权限都不得返回受保护体。仅本题单业务端点，不实现完整生产CORS框架。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实非root Linux回环WSGI HTTP请求、401/403/200及响应头/空预检验收，authenticate/authorize由可信教学回调提供；不是完整身份提供者、Cookie/CSRF或浏览器SOP原生验收。不改OpsForge实际登录流程、宿主身份或外部服务，不构建镜像。与Nginx069仅来源头匹配、权限025对象归属、质量008 CSRF写请求不同，本题验证两种控制在真实HTTP响应上的独立性。
rubric: CORS主要控制浏览器是否允许脚本读取跨源响应，不是用户身份或对象权限机制；非浏览器客户端不受相同约束
服务端仍需认证和资源授权，凭据请求的来源匹配也要准确
测试未授权客户端直接请求应被拒绝，而不是依赖浏览器报错

conversion.original_title: CORS允许某域访问，是否等于服务器已经授权该域用户读取数据？

import contextlib,http.client,os,secrets,sys,threading
from wsgiref.simple_server import make_server,WSGIRequestHandler
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
class Quiet(WSGIRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
allowed='http://trusted.example.invalid';other='http://untrusted.example.invalid';token=secrets.token_hex(24);limited=secrets.token_hex(24);secret=secrets.token_hex(24).encode();calls=[]
def authenticate(value):return 'reader' if value==token else 'limited' if value==limited else None
def authorize(identity,path):return identity=='reader' and path=='/protected'
def business(environ,start_response):
 assert environ['opsforge.identity']=='reader';calls.append(environ['PATH_INFO'])
 start_response('200 OK',[('Content-Type','text/plain'),('Content-Length',str(len(secret))),('Access-Control-Allow-Origin','*'),('Vary','Accept-Encoding')]);return [secret]
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:real_http_cors_readability_separate_from_user_authentication_and_authorization',flush=True)
try:wrapped=task.protect(business,authenticate,authorize,allowed)
except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('CORS/auth middleware creation failed') from error
server=make_server('127.0.0.1',0,wrapped,handler_class=Quiet);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
try:
 def request(origin=None,bearer=None,method='GET',path='/protected'):
  headers={}
  if origin is not None:headers['Origin']=origin
  if bearer is not None:headers['Authorization']='Bearer '+bearer
  if method=='OPTIONS':headers.update({'Access-Control-Request-Method':'GET','Access-Control-Request-Headers':'authorization'})
  connection=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',server.server_port,timeout=2)
  try:
   connection.request(method,path,headers=headers);response=connection.getresponse();body=response.read();return response.status,dict(response.getheaders()),body
  finally:connection.close()
 status,headers,body=request(allowed);assert status==401 and body!=secret and headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')=='Bearer','approved Origin bypassed user authentication'
 assert headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')==allowed and headers.get('Vary')=='Origin'
 status,headers,body=request(allowed,limited);assert status==403 and body!=secret and not calls,'authenticated user bypassed object authorization'
 status,headers,body=request(allowed,token);assert status==200 and body==secret and headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')==allowed and headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials')=='true'
 assert headers.get('Vary')=='Accept-Encoding, Origin','downstream cache variation was lost'
 status,headers,body=request(other,token);assert status==200 and body==secret and 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' not in headers and 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' not in headers,'CORS response readability was incorrectly treated as server authorization'
 status,headers,body=request(None,token);assert status==200 and body==secret and 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' not in headers
 status,headers,body=request(None,None);assert status==401 and body!=secret
 status,headers,body=request(allowed+'.evil.invalid',token);assert status==200 and body==secret and 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' not in headers
 before=len(calls);status,headers,body=request(allowed,method='OPTIONS');assert status==204 and not body and len(calls)==before
 assert headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin')==allowed and headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers')=='Authorization' and headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods')=='GET'
 status,headers,body=request(other,method='OPTIONS');assert status==204 and not body and 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' not in headers and len(calls)==before
 status,headers,body=request(allowed,token,path='/other');assert status==403 and body!=secret
 print('NATIVE_HTTP_TRUSTED_ORIGIN_STILL_401_OR_403_VALID_USER_WITHOUT_CORS_200_PREFLIGHT_NO_DATA',flush=True)
finally:
 server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3);assert not thread.is_alive()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
